item.title: Elder Scrolls Online studio insists shift from expansions to smaller seasonal updates unrelated to sweeping Microsoft layoffs
item.description: Following last week's announcement that long-running MMO The Elder Scrolls Online would be moving away from traditional major expansions to focus on smaller seasonal updates, developer ZeniMax Online has insisted the big shake-up is in no way related to last year's sweeping layoffs at parent company Microsoft, which heavily impacted the studio. Read more

item.title: Divinity: Original Sin 2 hits new post-launch-window high as Larian's bloodthirsty The Game Awards reveal boosts studio's back catalogue
item.description: Larian Studios' new Divinity game has been the talk of town since it was revealed at The Game Awards 2025. Even the comments on potential gen-AI use, ensuing backlash, and course-correction haven't sunk the excitement around the next RPG from the developers behind Baldur's Gate 3. In fact, the 2023 CRPG and the studio's previous game, Divinity: Original Sin 2, have seen a surge in popularity. Read more

item.title: Hitman: World of Assassination will finally let you use your PS5 save on Switch 2, plus other variations, from next month
item.description: As we prepare for IO Interactive's 007 First Light, set to finally launch in May, and celebrate Hitman 3's five-year anniversary, we've received news Hitman: World of Assassination is, at long last, getting cross-progression support. Read more

item.title: 2XKO review
item.description: A League of Legends fighting game is the sort of idea only the most stoned bozo, most gormless ruffian, could have dreamt up a decade or so ago. It stands in the day-dream pantheon of a Riot Games MMO (wait a minute), or some kind of League of Legends trading card game (hang on a second). Yet, despite the odds not only does such a game exist, but it's class A kino. Though, not without fault. Read more

item.title: 2025 breakout indie hit Ball x Pit to get two new characters, loads of new balls in new update
item.description: Kenny Sun and Friends' Ball x Pit was among Eurogamer's favourite games of 2025, so imagine our excitement when it was confirmed free content drops were set to arrive this year. Now, the wait for the first major update is almost over. Read more

item.title: Veteran World of Warcraft lead joins Riot Games as a producer on upcoming rival MMO
item.description: Raymond Bartos, producer on the World of Warcraft team, has announced his new role at a rival studio. He'll now be working on a whole new MMO, the much-anticipated and very mysterious Riot Games MMO no less. Read more
